description: Synthetic, non-executional example market context that intentionally omits the required structural feeds for every COMPUTABLE detector. Only a session clock is supplied. It proves that COMPUTABLE detectors refuse safely (REFUSE_TO_CLASSIFY) when required inputs are absent, instead of guessing. No real instrument, account, broker, order, fill, or P&L data is present.

session_clock.note: Session clock only; all structural market-data feeds are intentionally absent.
